title: Tooltip cursor
description: A tooltip that follows the pointer over its element, for charts, maps and large areas where a label pinned to one edge would be far from what's pointed at. Moves to the other side of the pointer near the window's edges; with the keyboard it sits under the focused element; on a touch screen it sits above the finger, which slides it from one to the next once held, or shows it on a link or a button by a long press. Hidden on Esc, read out by screen readers, never clipped. For a label pinned to an element, see the tooltip. Works inside Livewire components.
